name: Dan Kieft
inspiration: The AI-filmmaking tutorial channel youtube.com/@Dankieft (refs pulled from 0B_xyflXrwc, UxwV16jDglA, e9ZupmL9BcM). Screens that stand in a room in perspective and are pushed into continuously, zooms onto a named region of a screen, prompt walls that get highlighted live marker by marker, a permanent periwinkle-ringed PIP, serif chapter titles. Reference frames in references/.
summary: The long-form YouTube tutorial style. Use for 10-30 min walkthroughs, tool teardowns and courses — anywhere a lot of screen has to stay watchable while someone talks over it.
format: long-form YouTube (16:9). Not built for reels.

palette.notes: Exactly three saturated colours: yellow (the accent), royal (the graphics stage), electric blue (the second marker). Two stages that never mix in one shot — royal for built graphics, charcoal for 3D screen work. Sampled per-pixel from the refs. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Inter Tight ITALIC 800 caps is the signature — every pill leans forward. Instrument Serif is reserved for chapter titles and annotation labels, nothing else. Inter 24px carries prompt walls (small on purpose, it is a document). JetBrains Mono for badges and counters only.

motion: Three speeds. SNAP (markers, pills, numbers) expo.out ~0.36s. SETTLE (surfaces) ~0.62s with slight overshoot. DRIFT (the continuous camera push on any screen) 8-14s, power1.inOut, never eases out. The rule that defines the style: a screen is NEVER on frame without drifting, and the drift is still moving when the cut happens. The signature is the de-skew — rotateY eases from -13deg to -2.5deg during the approach; a flat scale() does not reproduce it.
transitions: Hard cuts between the two stages, never a dissolve. Prompt walls arrive whole and unhighlighted, then markers sweep left-to-right in sequence while the wall itself stays put. The PIP is permanent whenever a screen is up.

pacing.notes: Measured on 0B_xyflXrwc (1003s, 156 detected cuts). The hook is twice as fast as the body and is a 30-60s AI short film with tiny dialogue subtitles, not talking head.

cards.notes: THE signature move. Set --z-near to ~240px when no chapter line is used.
Region is described as --rx / --ry / --rw (percent of the screen, 16:9 box). Agent 3 sets those three per beat.

Le geste pedagogique central. Le pave arrive ENTIER et eteint, puis chaque bloc s'allume au marqueur. Deux couleurs : jaune et bleu electrique, pour opposer deux natures de contenu. Le texte passe en encre sur le jaune, en BLANC sur le bleu. Le corps reste a 24px : c'est un document, pas un titre — pour aider, zoomer (custom/screen-zoom-region), pas grossir.

Releve sur RlKg6oXLf7Y 1:21-1:28. Le titre entre PETIT et grossit pendant tout le plan ; la barre-pilule se deploie sous lui, PUIS le sous-titre la remplit de gauche a droite. Le contenant avant le contenu. Vignette inversee : centre plus sombre que les bords.

Releve sur RlKg6oXLf7Y 1:09-1:13. Sommaire qui PROMET au lieu d'expliquer : des extraits defilent, un cadenas ouvert numerote chacun. Le ruban est duplique pour boucler sans couture. Defilement lineaire, jamais resolu.

Releve sur RlKg6oXLf7Y 1:19-1:21. La scene abandonne le bleu maison et prend la couleur de l'outil montre : brume, lisere, texte. Agent 3 ne change que --tint. La frappe est un clip-path en paliers, pas un onUpdate — GSAP supprime ses callbacks au seek et le moteur rend en seekant.
